accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research. Brittle or damaged materials are available at the discretion of RAC.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: Expedited Access - Processing Level 1 - File-Level Access.
Records remain in original housing. Additional processing will be conducted in the future to improve description, enhance access, and long-term preservation.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: RAC has legal title, copyright, and literary rights in this collection, in so far as it holds them. RAC also has authority to grant permission to publish materials from this collection.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: Albert Kunstadter Family Foundation records primarily consists of grants, program files, and administrative records.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The Albert Kunstadter Family Foundation is a private foundation, incorporated in 1952, and located in New York, NY. The Foundation primarily funds general research and support. The initial focus of grants was in Chicago and the surrounding Chicagoland area, where its founder was based, and then the Foundation expanded support nationally throughout the United States with a focus on New York philanthropy and internationally as well, with a particular focus in Asia.
